exposure: having at least one vaginal birth
cohort: The study included 749 middle-aged Brazilian women aged 45 to 60 years.
finding: GSM was prevalent in 51.4% of the women, and its presence was associated with several factors including having a partner, topical estrogen treatment, depression/anxiety, and rheumatological diseases.
mod_finding: The absence of vaginal birth was related to GSM genital symptoms, while having at least one vaginal birth was associated with GSM urinary symptoms.
